verdicts.title: Commutator Subgroups of Singular Braid Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The singular braids with $n$ strands, $n \geq 3$, were introduced independently by Baez and Birman. It is known that the monoid formed by the singular braids is embedded in a group that is known as singular braid group, denoted by $SG_n$. There has been another generalization of braid groups, denoted by $GVB_n$, $n \geq 3$, which was introduced by Fang as a group of symmetries behind quantum quasi-shuffle structures. verdicts.title: Graph of groups decompositions of graph braid groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We provide an explicit construction that allows one to easily decompose a graph braid group as a graph of groups.
